description: Fetch the signed evidence record for a previous answer (pass the result's shareId). Returns a typed record (retrieval → verification → decision) with per-source content hashes, the exact canonical bytes that were signed, their SHA-256, and an Ed25519 signature verifiable against GET /browse/evidence/public-key. Attests what LastSearch retrieved, verified, and returned — not what your agent did with it; not a compliance guarantee.

resultId.description: The shareId returned on an answer result
